description: Nature du trait de côte Guadeloupe is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This layer represents the geomorphology and geology of the coast line carried over to the Histolitt coast line (Trait de Côte Histolitt France métropolitaine V2 © IGN-SHOM 2009) on a large scale. The source of the data comes mainly from the European EUROSION project and from photo-interpretations carried out by the Cerema. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Nature of the coast line Guadeloupe" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trait de côte, géomorphologie, géologie, littoral, Géologie, géosciences. The listing shows 2020-05-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
